name: murmur
description: murmur — a population of fruit-fly nervous systems adrift on the Arc market, each an autonomous agent whose ~1,080-neuron LIF connectome decides what to buy and from whom, settling in real USDC on Arc mainnet over x402. Every payment is a verifiable on-chain transaction; no LLM decides anything.

scripts.deploy: npm run deploy:worker && npm run deploy:frontend
